title: bella 4Qt Slim Air Fryer, Fits-anywhere™ Kitchenware, EverGood™ Ceramic Nonstick Coating, Adjustable Temperature, 6 Preset Cooking Options, 60 Min Auto Shutoff w Audible Tone, 3.3lb Capacity, Seaglass
reviews: Love love love. Cute color, slimmer profile than other 6qt. Quick to heat, consistent temp. Best airfryer ive used. Nice nonstick makes it super easy to clean, just a quick rinse and wipe. Has a raised tray/crisper that keeps food up off the bottom which is great for things like fries

I've never had an air fryer before, but I've always wanted to try it for sake of my health and WOW, what a great first experience! It's easy to use, easy to clean (get the parchment paper liners! I got silicon ones but they made my food taste weird) and it has multiple functionalities. Food comes out relatively quick as well, and everything is evenly cooked; maybe a little crispier on the edge of the tray, but that's all. I've eaten so many more veggies now than I have in the last 5 years because it comes out close to restaurant quality! I'm actually making apple chips right now with the dehyrdator function. FYI -- A lot of recipes say you have to "preheat" your air fryer, but that's not necessary with this model. There's no preheat function, you just set the desired setting and go! I have the 6QT and it's perfect for cooking for 1-2 people, depending on meal and portion size. I'd say if you have a family of 3-4+ you should look for a larger one. Also, no weird smells (that was important for my roommate) and the heat output doesn't feel dangerous at all! I was more scared by the warnings in the user manual than I needed to be.

Great quality air fryer with a large enough basket to cook for 3-5 people at a time. I love the color options, and we leave ours sitting out since it looks nice too. We use this almost daily (usually multiple times daily for our family of 5 with 3 growing boys) and have had it several months, no issues! Fries, chicken, etc are crispy. Even my husband said the other night while eating out, "Can't beat our air fryer foods at home though..."

This is a cute air fryer that matches my kitchen well. I've had it for maybe a month and it gets used daily. Its honestly pretty easy to clean and the buttons are easy to use. With the color I ordered I didn't have any issues reading the labels, but other reviews mentioned the blue one being difficult to read. I cook a few chicken strips or a bunch of nuggets and it is a good size. The reheat feature is nice so that I don't have to use a microwave. The first time I used this air fryer, it did smell of plastic or chemicals of some sort. However, that went away after a couple uses. Honestly for the price, I'm very impressed.

Perfect size & cooks well. But I can't see the buttons on the front. The print is really light. I have to use my phone or a magnifying glass to see which buttons to push. Also there is no hold button so when you stop it to turn anything over you have to start all the buttons all over again and remember how much time you had left.

Here’s your updated review with that added: --- ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I am OBSESSED with this air fryer! The **Bella 6 Qt Slim Air Fryer** is hands down the best one I’ve ever owned. First of all, the slim design is a game changer it truly fits anywhere and doesn’t take up a ton of counter space like most air fryers do. It looks so cute in my kitchen too (I got the Blossom color and love it I love anything pink!). The cooking performance is amazing. Everything comes out perfectly crispy on the outside and cooked evenly on the inside. I’ve done everything from breakfast sausage to potatoes and OMG GRILLED CHICKEN is PERFECT and it’s been flawless every time. The preset options make it super easy, but I also love being able to adjust the temperature when I want more control. One thing I didn’t expect it's SO quiet. You honestly barely hear it running. I didn’t realize how loud my old air fryer was until I got this one! The ceramic nonstick coating is another huge plus—nothing sticks and cleanup is SO easy. That alone makes it worth it for me. Also love the 6 qt size it’s perfect for feeding my family without having to cook in multiple batches. If you’re on the fence, just get it. This one is actually worth the hype!

I really like this air fryer. It’s easy to use & works very well but at first it’s hard to read the letters but after using it for 3 times I kinda memorized already which button to push every time I use it. And also, really easy to clean!

This is my first air fryer and absolutely love it. Took a while to get this color and was well worth the wait. Other colors can be picked up and or received sooner. Better than a microwave and safer. I use use it every day and don’t ever want to be without it. Beautiful color, size and easy to clean. Recommend to everyone that eats.
